dell-xps-touchpad-haptics on Omarchy

Dials in the click feel of Dell XPS haptic touchpads under Omarchy.

Package data synced 2026-10-20 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install dell-xps-touchpad-haptics on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add dell-xps-touchpad-haptics. It is a 9.9 KB download (15.4 KB installed), version 1.0.0-4, licensed MIT. Synaptics haptic touchpad presets for Dell XPS on Omarchy. Free and open source (MIT licensed).

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install dell-xps-touchpad-haptics on Omarchy

This package installs Omarchy's presets and control hooks for the Synaptics haptic touchpad found on newer Dell XPS laptops, exposing a Trigger > Hardware > Touchpad Haptics menu to switch the simulated click strength between low, mid, and high. It's a small, targeted driver-adjacent utility rather than a standalone app, only relevant if you're running Omarchy on the specific Dell XPS hardware it targets.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add dell-xps-touchpad-haptics
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.0.0-4:
    pacman -Qi dell-xps-touchpad-haptics

Open and use dell-xps-touchpad-haptics

dell-xps-touchpad-haptics has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql dell-xps-touchpad-haptics | grep /usr/bin/

dell-xps-touchpad-haptics requirements and compatibility

  • A Dell XPS laptop with a Synaptics haptic touchpad (only certain controller revisions, e.g. 06CB:D01A, are supported; newer 06CB:D01D units have reported compatibility issues)
  • Running the Omarchy desktop environment

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • python

Pricing and license

Free and open source (MIT licensed). License: MIT.

Uninstall dell-xps-touchpad-haptics

omarchy pkg drop dell-xps-touchpad-haptics

Frequently asked questions

How do I install dell-xps-touchpad-haptics on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add dell-xps-touchpad-haptics. The download is 9.9 KB and it takes 15.4 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is dell-xps-touchpad-haptics free?

Free and open source (MIT licensed). The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall dell-xps-touchpad-haptics?

Run omarchy pkg drop dell-xps-touchpad-haptics. It removes the package from your system.

What does dell-xps-touchpad-haptics depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: python. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is dell-xps-touchpad-haptics a desktop app?

No. dell-xps-touchpad-haptics has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is dell-xps-touchpad-haptics in the official Omarchy repo?
